function.name: errorinfo_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface and return a pointer to that interface if it is supported.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an interface that the caller is querying.

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *obj contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *obj is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, and E_NOINTERFACE if it is not.

function.name: CreateErrorInfo
function.description: This function creates an error information object, initializes it, and returns a pointer to this object.

parameters.name: ret
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an ICreateErrorInfo interface. This parameter is used to return the created error information object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if successful, E_INVALIDARG if the argument is invalid, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: GetErrorInfo
function.description: This function retrieves the error information for the current thread by calling the com_get_tlsdata function. If there is no error information, it returns S_FALSE and sets the error_info to NULL. If there is error information, it sets the error_info to the error information and clears the error information from the thread.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: Reserved for future use. Must be zero.

parameters.name: error_info
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a IErrorInfo interface that receives the error object.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an HRESULT error code.

function.name: SetErrorInfo
function.description: This function sets error information in the thread local storage. If there is already error information present, it releases it before setting the new error information. If the reserved parameter is non-zero, it returns an invalid argument error.

parameters.name: reserved
parameters.description: This parameter is reserved and should be zero.

parameters.name: error_info
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the error information to be set.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It can be S_OK if the operation is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the reserved parameter is non-zero, or other error codes if there are failures in getting the thread local storage or releasing the existing error information.
